units.source_text: 与此同时，从笠置山也吹来一股风，风中同样飘荡着温柔的声音：

en.t: At the same time, a gust of wind also blew from Mount Kasagi, and in the wind there drifted the same gentle voice:

units.source_text: “发长彦君，发长彦君，我是笠置山的笠公主。”

en.t: “Prince Kemanagahiko, Prince Kemanagahiko, I am Princess Kasa of Mount Kasagi.”
